# Malady Wise

> Free daily medical puzzles and games, plus plain-English health fact sheets, blood test explainers, exercise handouts, calculators and evidence-based deep dives for clinicians. Made with AI tools and overseen by an Australian GP. General education, not personal medical advice.

- Audience: the public, students and health professionals worldwide; Australian details where relevant.
- Spelling: Australian/British English. Units: SI.
- How pages are made: https://maladywise.com/about/#how-we-make-pages
- Privacy: https://maladywise.com/privacy/
- Sponsorship and advertising policy: https://maladywise.com/sponsorship/

## Daily medical puzzles and games

- [Anatomegaly: Daily Anatomy Quiz](https://maladywise.com/anatomegaly/): Anatomegaly is a free daily anatomy quiz: name the highlighted structure, the bone or the nerve in five quick rounds. For students, nurses and doctors.
- [Arcade Games: Basil + Clover, Stackulus and Mergeon](https://maladywise.com/arcade/): Free medical arcade games: Basil + Clover (cats, chaos and a vet), Stackulus (falling organs, daily challenge) and Mergeon (merge microbes up to a brain).
- [Arrhythmix: ECG Quiz (Free, Twice Weekly)](https://maladywise.com/arrhythmix/): Arrhythmix is a free ECG quiz every Monday and Thursday: a short case and an ECG on standard paper. Pick the rhythm in three tries and see the key features.
- [Basil + Clover: Free Cat Arcade Game](https://maladywise.com/basil-clover/): Basil + Clover is a free cat arcade game: help Basil kick everything off the kitchen bench, then survive a trip to the vet with his sister Clover.
- [Comorbix: Daily Medical Grouping Game](https://maladywise.com/comorbix/): Comorbix is a free daily medical grouping game: sixteen medical terms, four hidden groups of four. Find the links before you run out of mistakes.
- [Glimpsis: Spot the Diagnosis Photo Quiz](https://maladywise.com/glimpsis/): Glimpsis is a free daily spot the diagnosis photo quiz: one real clinical image, six options, three tries. Tuesdays add Glimpsathon: 10 signs in one go.
- [Gridectomy: Medical Mini Crossword](https://maladywise.com/gridectomy/): Gridectomy is a free daily medical mini crossword: a five-by-five grid with medical clues. Most people finish in a few minutes. New grid every day.
- [Linkase: Daily Medical Word Chain Game](https://maladywise.com/linkase/): Linkase is a free daily medical word chain game: each word links to the next to make a phrase, like blood, pressure, sore, throat. Fill the chain.
- [Medical Games: Zebritis Zebra Game + Free Daily Quizzes](https://maladywise.com/medical-games/): Play Zebritis, a free daily medical zebra game: name the rare diagnosis. Plus Dxtective diagnosis cases, anatomy, ECG and medical trivia quizzes.
- [Mergeon: Free Organ Merge Game](https://maladywise.com/mergeon/): Mergeon is a free organ merge game: drop organs, match two of a kind and merge your way from microbe to brain. Same drops for everyone, every day.
- [Morphemia: Medical Word-Building Game](https://maladywise.com/morphemia/): Morphemia is a free daily medical word-building game: make words from seven letters, always using the centre letter. Medical words score double.
- [Opacitis: X-ray Quiz (Daily Radiology Puzzle)](https://maladywise.com/opacitis/): Opacitis is a free daily X-ray quiz: one real X-ray, CT or ultrasound image and a short scenario. Name the diagnosis from six options in three tries.
- [Panelysis: Blood Test Quiz](https://maladywise.com/panelysis/): Panelysis is a free daily blood test quiz: read a fictional patient's blood results and pick the diagnosis in three tries. Learn to read blood tests.
- [Sensitosis: Sensitivity and Specificity Game](https://maladywise.com/sensitosis/): Sensitosis is a free daily game about sensitivity and specificity: guess how good real medical tests are, then see 100 people and the source.
- [Stackulus: Free Falling-Block Organ Game](https://maladywise.com/stackulus/): Stackulus is a free falling-block arcade game with organs: stack them, clear rows and learn an organ fact every level. Daily challenge and world board.
- [Sudokrine: Medical Sudoku](https://maladywise.com/sudokrine/): Sudokrine is a free daily medical sudoku with a hidden word: fill the grid with letters, then spell the hormone or gland. 6x6 early week, 9x9 at weekends.
- [Suturix: Medical Word Search](https://maladywise.com/suturix/): Suturix is a free daily medical word search: find the hidden theme words, plus a spangram that names the theme. Every letter is used once.
- [Wordemic: Daily Medical Word Game](https://maladywise.com/wordemic/): Wordemic is a free daily medical word game: guess the five-letter medical word in six tries (eight letters on Long Fridays). Australian spelling, no sign-up.
- [Zebritis: Rare Disease Quiz Game](https://maladywise.com/zebritis/): Zebritis is a free daily rare disease quiz game: name any correct answer to a medical prompt. Answers score 1 to 20: the rarer, the more points.

## Health fact sheets (conditions)

- [22q11.2 Deletion (DiGeorge) Syndrome: Signs and Care](https://maladywise.com/22q11-deletion-syndrome/): 22q11.2 deletion syndrome (DiGeorge, VCFS): heart, palate, calcium, immunity, learning and mental health, how it’s diagnosed, check-ups and support.
- [About Malady Wise](https://maladywise.com/about/): About Malady Wise: free daily medical puzzles, plain-English health fact sheets and medicine guides, drafted with AI tools and overseen by an Australian GP.
- [Achilles Tendinopathy: Exercises and Treatment](https://maladywise.com/achilles/): Achilles tendon pain: the calf-loading exercises that work, how long recovery takes, shockwave, injections and what to skip.
- [Acne Treatment: Creams, Tablets and What Works](https://maladywise.com/acne/): Acne treatment: benzoyl peroxide, retinoids, combination gels, antibiotics, the pill and isotretinoin, rated by the strength of the evidence.
- [Addison’s Disease: Symptoms, Adrenal Crisis and Treatment](https://maladywise.com/addisons-disease/): Addison’s disease (primary adrenal insufficiency): tiredness, weight loss, salt craving and darker skin.
- [ADHD in Adults: Signs, Diagnosis and Treatment](https://maladywise.com/adhd-adults/): ADHD in adults: how it shows up, getting diagnosed later in life, work adjustments, medicines, driving and what to skip.
- [ADHD in Children: Signs, Diagnosis and School](https://maladywise.com/adhd-kids/): ADHD in children: early signs, how diagnosis works, school adjustments, parent programs and how ADHD medicines help.
- [ADHD: Symptoms, Diagnosis and Medication](https://maladywise.com/adhd/): ADHD (attention deficit hyperactivity disorder) in children and adults: evidence-based treatment options in plain English.
- [Aluminium: Antacids, Deodorant, Vaccines and Dementia Myths](https://maladywise.com/aluminium/): Aluminium explained: where you’re exposed, when it’s genuinely a problem (kidney failure), and what the evidence says about aluminium, deodorant, cookware.
- [Anal Fissure: Symptoms, Treatment and Healing Time](https://maladywise.com/anal-fissure/): Anal fissure: why it hurts, how long it takes to heal, fibre, GTN and diltiazem creams, botox and surgery, rated by evidence.
- [Anaphylaxis: Signs and How to Use an Adrenaline Injector](https://maladywise.com/anaphylaxis/): Anaphylaxis signs, ASCIA first aid steps, how to use an adrenaline autoinjector, action plans and common triggers. If in doubt, give adrenaline.
- [Anxiety: Symptoms, Panic Attacks, CBT and Medicines](https://maladywise.com/anxiety/): Anxiety: generalised anxiety, panic and social anxiety, what CBT and medicines can do, what to skip, and where to get help.
- [Arsenic: Sources, Rice, Seafood and Testing Pitfalls](https://maladywise.com/arsenic/): Arsenic exposure explained: toxic inorganic arsenic in water, rice and some traditional medicines, why seafood makes urine tests look high.
- [Asthma: Inhalers, Action Plans and First Aid](https://maladywise.com/asthma/): Asthma for adults and children: symptoms, first aid, relievers vs preventers, the newer anti-inflammatory reliever, and why technique and an action plan matter.
- [Atrial Fibrillation (AF): Symptoms and Treatment](https://maladywise.com/atrial-fibrillation/): Atrial fibrillation: symptoms, why it raises stroke risk, blood thinners, rate and rhythm control, ablation, and the lifestyle changes that cut episodes.
- [Atypical Symptoms: Heart Attack, Stroke and Sepsis Without the Textbook Signs](https://maladywise.com/atypical-presentations/): Heart attacks without chest pain, strokes that look like confusion, sepsis without a fever: how emergencies often look in women, older people.
- [Autism in Adults: Late Diagnosis and Support](https://maladywise.com/autism-adults/): Autism in adults: signs, getting diagnosed later in life, masking and burnout, work adjustments and support that actually helps.
- [Autism in Children: Signs, Assessment, Support](https://maladywise.com/autism-kids/): Autism in children: early signs, how assessment works, NDIS and Medicare help, school adjustments, and supports that respect who your child is.
- [Autism: Signs, Diagnosis and Support](https://maladywise.com/autism/): Autism in children and adults: diagnosis, supports that help, and therapies to avoid, in plain English.
- [B12 Deficiency: Symptoms, Tablets and Injections](https://maladywise.com/b12/): Vitamin B12 deficiency: symptoms, causes like pernicious anaemia and metformin, and B12 tablets versus injections.
- [Bedwetting in Children: Causes and What Helps](https://maladywise.com/bedwetting/): Bedwetting (nocturnal enuresis) in children: how common it is, why it happens, when to treat, bedwetting alarms, desmopressin and practical tips.
- [Belly Button Problems in Babies: Granuloma, Hernia](https://maladywise.com/umbilical-problems/): Baby belly button problems: umbilical cord care, umbilical granuloma (a moist pink lump), umbilical hernia (an outie that bulges).
- [Bell’s Palsy: Symptoms, Treatment and Recovery Time](https://maladywise.com/bells-palsy/): Bell’s palsy: sudden one-sided face weakness. How to tell it from a stroke, why steroids within 72 hours matter, eye care, and how long recovery takes.

- [Plantar Fasciitis Exercises (Plantar Heel Pain)](https://maladywise.com/exercises/plantar-heel-pain/): Exercises for plantar fasciitis and plantar heel pain: heavy heel raises, plantar fascia and calf stretches, plus what else works. Printable.
- [Plantar Fasciitis Stretches and Exercises](https://maladywise.com/plantar-fasciitis/exercises/): Plantar fasciitis stretches and exercises: calf and arch stretches, the heavy heel-raise program from a Danish trial, plus taping and insert tips.
- [Rotator Cuff Exercises: 7 Moves for a Sore Shoulder](https://maladywise.com/rotator-cuff/exercises/): Rotator cuff exercises for tendon pain and tears: wall holds, band and side-lying rotation, rows and wall slides, with diagrams, pain rules and red flags.
- [Scapula Fracture Exercises: Week-by-Week Rehab](https://maladywise.com/exercises/scapula-fracture/): Scapula (shoulder blade) fracture rehab without surgery, week by week: sling, gentle early moves, then strength from week 7. With diagrams. Printable.
- [Shoulder Impingement Exercises: 6 Moves](https://maladywise.com/exercises/shoulder/): Shoulder impingement exercises from the Swedish trial that cut surgery rates: slow rotator cuff work, shoulder-blade strength and a stretch, with diagrams.
- [Tennis Elbow Exercises (Lateral Elbow Pain)](https://maladywise.com/exercises/tennis-elbow/): Exercises for tennis elbow: isometric holds, slow wrist strengthening and grip work, plus what to avoid. Evidence-based and printable.
- [Tennis Elbow Exercises: Printable Home Program](https://maladywise.com/tennis-elbow/exercises/): Tennis elbow exercises: slow wrist lifts, holds, grip and forearm turning, with the pain rules and 8-week timeline used in Australian trials. Printable.

## Comparisons

- [Ibuprofen vs Paracetamol: Which Painkiller Is Best?](https://maladywise.com/compare/ibuprofen-vs-paracetamol/): Ibuprofen vs paracetamol: which works better for back pain, period pain, arthritis and fever in children, who should avoid each, pregnancy.
- [Medicine and Symptom Comparisons: X vs Y](https://maladywise.com/compare/): Plain-English comparisons: semaglutide vs tirzepatide, ibuprofen vs paracetamol, cold vs flu, sertraline vs escitalopram and vitamin D3 vs D2.
- [Semaglutide vs Tirzepatide (Ozempic vs Mounjaro)](https://maladywise.com/compare/ozempic-vs-mounjaro/): Semaglutide (Ozempic, Wegovy) vs tirzepatide (Mounjaro): head-to-head weight loss in SURMOUNT-5, diabetes results, side effects and PBS status in Australia.
- [Sertraline vs Escitalopram (Zoloft vs Lexapro)](https://maladywise.com/compare/sertraline-vs-escitalopram/): Sertraline (Zoloft) vs escitalopram (Lexapro): how well they work, side effects, heart rhythm (QT), interactions, pregnancy and breastfeeding, and PBS cost.
- [Vitamin D3 vs D2: Which Supplement Is Better?](https://maladywise.com/compare/vitamin-d3-vs-d2/): Vitamin D3 (colecalciferol) vs D2 (ergocalciferol): which raises blood levels better, daily vs big doses, vegan sources, who needs a supplement and how much.

## Deep dives for health professionals

- [ADHD: deep dive](https://maladywise.com/deep-dives/adhd/): ADHD across the lifespan for clinicians, adults in focus: DSM-5-TR criteria and the adult 5-symptom threshold, prevalence, heritability, history, stimulant.

- [Autism: deep dive](https://maladywise.com/deep-dives/autism/): Autism across the lifespan for clinicians, with adults in focus: DSM-5-TR and ICD-11, the rise in prevalence (1 in 31 in the US), sex differences.
- [Behçet's disease: deep dive](https://maladywise.com/deep-dives/behcets/): Behçet's disease for doctors: ISG and ICBD criteria, Silk Road epidemiology, HLA-B51 and ERAP1, organ-by-organ EULAR 2018 management, apremilast, mortality.
- [Coeliac disease: deep dive](https://maladywise.com/deep-dives/coeliac/): Coeliac disease for doctors: who to test, serology accuracy, no-biopsy pathways, gluten thresholds, refractory disease, mortality and the drug pipeline.
- [Deep Dives for Doctors](https://maladywise.com/deep-dives/): A weekly evidence-dense overview for doctors: definition, pathophysiology, epidemiology, treatment, trials and the gaps nobody has filled yet.
- [Disorders of gut–brain interaction: deep dive](https://maladywise.com/deep-dives/dgbi/): DGBI for clinicians: Rome IV to Rome V, IBS and functional dyspepsia mechanisms, positive diagnosis, treatments with effect sizes and Australian drug status.
- [Hypermobility (hEDS, HSD): deep dive](https://maladywise.com/deep-dives/hypermobility/): Hypermobility for clinicians: Beighton limits, 2017 hEDS and HSD criteria, the EDS family and vascular red flags, POTS and MCAS claims, and what works.
- [Interstitial lung disease: deep dive](https://maladywise.com/deep-dives/ild/): Interstitial lung disease for clinicians: IPF and progressive pulmonary fibrosis, HRCT patterns, MDT diagnosis, antifibrotics with effect sizes, PBS status, silicosis and new drugs.
- [ME/CFS (Chronic Fatigue Syndrome): Deep Dive](https://maladywise.com/deep-dives/me-cfs/): ME/CFS for clinicians: case definitions, post-exertional malaise, epidemiology, triggers incl.
- [Mould exposure and health: deep dive](https://maladywise.com/deep-dives/mould/): Mould and health for clinicians: what damp and mould really cause (asthma, rhinitis, hypersensitivity pneumonitis, ABPA, invasive disease), IOM and WHO.
- [Pelvic congestion syndrome: deep dive](https://maladywise.com/deep-dives/pelvic-congestion-syndrome/): Pelvic congestion syndrome for clinicians: SVP classification, ovarian vein reflux, nutcracker and iliac compression, duplex criteria.
- [Peptides: deep dive](https://maladywise.com/deep-dives/peptides/): Peptides for clinicians: approved peptide medicines, GLP-1s and compounding, collagen, BPC-157, TB-500, GHK-Cu, melanotan, GH secretagogues, TGA law and safety.
- [POTS: a practical deep dive for GPs](https://maladywise.com/deep-dives/pots/): POTS for clinicians: HRS, CCS and 2026 consensus criteria, a step-by-step active stand test, what to exclude, red flags, non-drug care, off-label medicines.
- [Prostate cancer: deep dive](https://maladywise.com/deep-dives/prostate-cancer/): Prostate cancer for doctors: the 2026 Australian PSA guideline, ERSPC and CAP, overdiagnosis, active surveillance, ProtecT, metastatic intensification.
- [Stroke: deep dive](https://maladywise.com/deep-dives/stroke/): Stroke for doctors: GBD 2021 burden, INTERSTROKE risk, pathophysiology, thrombolysis, thrombectomy, ICH care, secondary prevention.
- [Type 2 diabetes: deep dive](https://maladywise.com/deep-dives/type-2-diabetes/): Type 2 diabetes for clinicians: 589 million adults, diagnosis and HbA1c pitfalls, SGLT2 and GLP-1 outcome trials, remission, tirzepatide.
